title: Keep the KRN ready-queue prompt out of worker threads
body:
Outcome: a `krn worker` Codex thread no longer receives the session-start developer message "KRN ready queue: ... Claim one with `krn task claim <id> --actor <actor>`", or that message is suppressed for worker runs, so workers do not try to mutate tracker state (KRN-11).
Evidence: live proof turn for t-t8v24zs (`.krn/runs/lead/worker-turn-finish/live/rounds/001/report.json`, checks) ran `krn task claim t-t8v24zs --actor codex` (exit 64) after that injected message; also visible in rollout 01a1a12e (first developer message after the AGENTS.md block). Source of the hook not found in the repository by text search; check Codex hooks in ~/.codex and the project's .codex config.
Proof: a fixture or live worker thread start shows no ready-queue message, and a lead session still gets it.
